projects.title: SAV: McIntosh - Purrysburg 230 kV Reactors
projects.summary: Install reactors on the McIntosh - Purrysburg (Black and White) 230kV tie lines at McIntosh. Rebuild 0.1 miles (GPC portion) for both lines to (2) 200C 1351 ACSS conductor.

evidence.exactExcerpt: Rebuild 0.1 miles (GPC portion) for both lines to (2) 200C 1351 ACSS conductor.

places.label: McIntosh
places.coordinateSource: OSM way/121624352 power=substation name=McIntosh Substation operator=Georgia Power voltage=230000
places.validation: Fact-check: this is the Georgia Power McIntosh substation next to Plant McIntosh in Effingham County (zone 219). Overpass (re-queried) shows the 2-circuit 230 kV way/185380583 leaving it for SC, and the 115 kV lines (way/1015932064 to Goshen and way/185380584 to SC) also end here, so it is the 230/115 kV McIntosh named in SERTP 2014. I did not use West McIntosh (500 kV, way/121624371) or the McIntosh CC switchyard (way/863571829).

places.label: Purrysburg
places.coordinateSource: OSM way/185380609 power=substation substation=transmission voltage=230000;115000 (unnamed, no operator), identified by line topology (Overpass mirror, re-queried 2026-09-26); Nominatim Purrysburg Road, Baker Hill, Jasper County SC (way/12420907, 32.36908,-81.12146) is about 95 m away
places.validation: Fact-check: I re-traced the topology. The only 2-circuit 230 kV line from McIntosh into SC (way/185380583, 4.43 mi, plus way/185380585, 0.28 mi, 4.71 mi in total) ends at this unnamed 230/115 kV transmission substation in Jasper County, SC. It does not end at the DESC Jasper generating switchyard (way/185380597). A 230 kV line also leaves this substation toward the Bluffton area (way/185381110, 19.6 mi), which fits a Santee Cooper (SCPSA) station, as SERTP 2014 p.45 says. I confirmed with Nominatim that Purrysburg Road (way/12420907) is next to it. The researcher's EIPC 4.79 mi circuit length is not in the cache, so I could not re-verify it. The identification does not depend on it.

constructionWindows.note: Project window as published (Start Date → Need Date); the months of field work within it are not stated, so only the bounds are used.

caveats: The reactors are installed at McIntosh, and the GPC rebuild is only 0.1 mi at the McIntosh end. Purrysburg is on the SC side. SERTP 2014 p.45 (sertp-2014-plan, excerpt verified) calls it 'Purrysburg (SCPSA)', so it is a Santee Cooper substation, not a DESC one. The DESC Jasper Generating Plant switchyard (OSM way/185380597, 'Jasper Substation', 230 kV generation) is about 0.9 km south and is a different facility.
Listed with project sponsor “SAV” (Georgia Power's Savannah area) in the Ten-Year Plan summary table.
